name: spamtroll/ips-app
description: Spamtroll Anti-Spam application for IPS Community Suite.

scripts-descriptions.lint: Check code style without modifying files
scripts-descriptions.lint:fix: Auto-format code to match code style
scripts-descriptions.hooks:preprocess: Rewrite hooks/*.php the way the IPS Suite does, into build/hooks-preprocessed/
scripts-descriptions.stan: Run PHPStan static analysis (preprocesses the hooks first)
scripts-descriptions.manifests: Check data/*.json manifests against the files and settings they name
scripts-descriptions.regression: Run the hook tests against the pre-fix hooks and require them to fail
scripts-descriptions.peck: Run the peck spell checker over identifiers and docblocks
scripts-descriptions.qa: Full quality gate: lint check, static analysis, spell-check, and tests
